---
name: slack-api-interaction
description: Interact with the Slack Web API to send and schedule messages, read conversation history, list channels and users, open DMs, upload files, and manage reactions using bot or user tokens. Use when Gemini CLI needs to perform Slack API operations such as posting a message to a channel or DM, fetching channel history, listing users or channels, uploading files, adding reactions, opening Block Kit modals, or debugging Slack API responses and errors.
---

# Slack API Interaction

Work directly with the Slack Web API (`https://slack.com/api/`) over HTTPS. Every endpoint returns JSON.

## Authentication

- Obtain a token from a Slack app: bot token (`xoxb-...`) or user token (`xoxp-...`).
- Send it as a bearer header on every request: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- Read the token from an environment variable (e.g. `SLACK_TOKEN`); never hardcode, log, or echo tokens.
- Verify credentials first with `auth.test`, which returns the bot/user ID, team name, and workspace URL.

## Calling the API

- Base URL: `https://slack.com/api/<method>`.
- Most methods are POST with `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` or JSON bodies; a few support GET query params.
- Responses always include `ok` (boolean). On failure, `error` holds a machine-readable code (e.g. `not_in_channel`) and `response_metadata.messages` may hold a human-readable hint.
- Most API errors return HTTP 200 with `ok: false`. HTTP 429 means rate limited (honor the `Retry-After` header); HTTP 401/403 indicate bad or insufficient auth.

### Minimal example (curl)

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"channel":"C1234567890","text":"Hello from Gemini CLI!"}'
```

### Minimal example (Python, stdlib)

```python
import json, os, urllib.request

def slack(method, payload):
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"https://slack.com/api/{method}",
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SLACK_TOKEN']}",
                 "Content-type": "application/json"},
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        result = json.load(resp)
    if not result.get("ok"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Slack {method} failed: {result.get('error')}")
    return result

slack("chat.postMessage", {"channel": "C1234567890", "text": "Hello from Gemini CLI!"})
```

Always check `ok` and surface the `error` string to the user instead of dumping raw JSON.

## Core workflow

1. Verify the token: `auth.test`.
2. Resolve names to IDs: endpoints expect channel IDs (`C...`) and user IDs (`U...`). Look up names via `conversations.list` (channels) and `users.list` (users).
3. Open DM channels with `conversations.open` (`users` = comma-separated user IDs); the DM channel ID is in the response.
4. Post with `chat.postMessage`; check `ok`.
5. Keep related messages in a thread by passing the parent message's `thread_ts`.

## Common methods

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `auth.test` | Verify token and get identity |
| `chat.postMessage` | Send a message to a channel or DM |
| `chat.update` / `chat.delete` | Edit or delete a message (by `ts`) |
| `chat.scheduleMessage` | Schedule a message (`post_at` = Unix timestamp) |
| `conversations.list` | List channels (`types=public_channel,private_channel,im,mpim`) |
| `conversations.info` / `history` / `members` | Channel details, messages, members |
| `conversations.open` | Open a DM or multi-person DM |
| `conversations.join` | Have the bot join a public channel |
| `users.list` / `users.info` | List or fetch users |
| `files.upload` | Upload a file (params: `channels`, `content` or `file`, `filename`) |
| `files.getUploadURLExternal` + `files.completeUploadExternal` | Upload large files in chunks (newer flow) |
| `reactions.add` / `reactions.remove` | Add or remove emoji reactions |
| `views.open` / `views.publish` | Show Block Kit modals / publish home tabs |

## Formatting and Block Kit

- mrkdwn syntax: `*bold*`, `_italic_`, `` `code` ``, `>quote`, `<https://example.com|Link text>`, `<@U123>` mentions, `<#C123>` channel links.
- Use Block Kit JSON (`type: section`, `actions`, `divider`, `image`, ...) for rich messages; `text` blocks accept mrkdwn.
- Plain-text messages render markdown by default; pass `mrkdwn: false` to disable.

## Pagination, limits, and rate limits

- Pagination is cursor-based: pass `limit` plus the `cursor` from `response_metadata.next_cursor` on each page until no cursor is returned. Never loop without advancing the cursor.
- Limits: `conversations.history` max 999 (default 100); `users.list` max 1000; `conversations.list` max 200.
- Rate limits are per-method tiers (roughly Tier 1: ~1 req/s, Tier 2: ~20 req/s, Tier 3: ~50 req/s, Tier 4: ~100 req/s). On 429, wait `Retry-After` seconds and retry with exponential backoff.
- Request only needed scopes. Common ones: `chat:write`, `channels:read`, `channels:history`, `users:read`, `files:write`, `reactions:write`, `im:write`.

## Common errors

| error | Meaning / fix |
|---|---|
| `invalid_auth` | Bad token; re-check the token and app |
| `missing_scope` | Token lacks the required scope; add it to the app and reinstall |
| `channel_not_found` | Wrong channel ID; verify via `conversations.list` |
| `not_in_channel` | Bot is not a member; use `conversations.join` (public) or invite it (private) |
| `is_archived` | Channel is archived |
| `rate_limited` | HTTP 429; wait for `Retry-After` |
| `msg_too_long` | Text exceeds 40,000 chars; split it or attach as a file |
| `invalid_blocks` | Block Kit JSON is malformed |

## Do

- Use channel/user IDs rather than names whenever an endpoint expects them.
- Check `ok` on every call and report `error` strings clearly.
- Use `thread_ts` to keep related messages threaded.
- Prefer bot identity (`as_user` default) unless user-token behavior is explicitly required.

## Don't

- Don't store, log, or echo tokens.
- Don't assume a name is an ID; resolve through `conversations.list` / `users.list`.
- Don't paginate without using the returned `cursor`.
- Don't ignore 429 responses or retry without backoff.
